## About
TMT Enterprises, Inc. works out of a yard on Oakland Road in San Jose, supplying bulk materials to municipalities, contractors, golf courses, parks departments, agriculture and nurseries.
The range runs from premium golf course sand to trench fill sand, crushed rock, base rock, gypsum, lime, bark and fill dirt, plus lightweight soil for on-structure applications and decorative aggregates. Our own trucks handle delivery.
Customers rate us 4.6 from 22 reviews on Google. One reviewer said we will help you work through getting materials approved by architects and engineers and then delivered.

## Services
- Infield Mix for Baseball & Softball: Infield material for ball fields, used by parks departments, leagues and schools.
- Golf Course Sand & Mixes: Sands and mixes for golf course maintenance and construction.
- Gravel, Drain Rock & Road Base: Aggregates for drainage, base and paving work.
- Topsoil & Sandy Loam: Soils for landscaping and planting.
- Decomposed Granite: DG, including DG with stabilizer, as one customer uses.
- Agricultural Gypsum & Lime: Soil amendments for vineyards, farms and growers.
- Organic Compost & Amendments: Organic material to build up soil.
- Bark & Wood Mulch Materials: Bark and mulch for landscape beds.

## FAQ
Q: Can you find or mix a material you don't normally stock?
A: A customer wrote that TMT has, can mix or will locate specialized materials. Call us with your spec and we'll see what we can do.

Q: Who do you supply?
A: Municipalities, contractors, golf courses, parks departments, agriculture, nurseries and others.

Q: How do I spot the yard on Oakland Road?
A: Coming from the East Bay, look for the 8' tall tan fence across the whole yard.

Q: Can I send an order by email?
A: Yes. You can reach the office at info@tmtenterprises.net or by phone.
